name: Teamarr Assistant
description: Helps Teamarr work with Dispatcharr. Tags regional sports network streams with their team(s) so Teamarr can sort them into home and away feeds, and starts a Teamarr generation when new streams appear in the M3U groups you choose, so channels show up soon after your provider posts them.
author: Brxdy22

fields.label: Team tags: how to fill this in
fields.help_text: One row per channel. Channel: text to find in the stream name or tvg-id (case-insensitive), e.g. YES NETWORK. Team(s): full team names exactly as Teamarr/ESPN spells them, comma-separated, e.g. Brooklyn Nets, New York Yankees. Use Add row for more channels; the bin icon deletes one. Save, then Apply.

fields.label: Teamarr sync
fields.help_text: After each refresh of the M3U account below, compares the stream names in the groups below with the last check. If new ones appear, a Teamarr generation starts. Dispatcharr only sees provider changes when it refreshes, so give the M3U account a frequent refresh schedule. Time-windowed streams only attach and detach during a generation, so keep Teamarr's schedule running, or set a daily run and raise Teamarr's stream pre-buffer to cover the gap.

fields.label: Start Teamarr when new streams appear
Teamarr URL
fields.help_text: Address Dispatcharr can reach Teamarr at.

fields.label: M3U account
fields.help_text: The M3U account to watch. To see a new account here, press Reload Plugin at the top of this page.

fields.label: Groups to watch
fields.help_text: Enabled groups from your M3U accounts, with the account in brackets. To see a new group here, press Reload Plugin at the top of this page.

fields.label: Only count streams dated today
fields.help_text: Ignores streams whose name carries another date. Names with no date always count.

fields.label: New streams needed
fields.help_text: How many new streams it takes to start a generation.

fields.label: Minimum minutes between generations
fields.help_text: New streams found sooner wait for the next refresh.

fields.label: Daily run time
fields.help_text: The first refresh at or after this time starts one generation, which lets you turn Teamarr's own scheduler off. New streams found earlier that day wait for it.

actions.label: Apply Tags
actions.description: Tags every matching stream now. Also runs after each M3U refresh, followed by the Teamarr sync check.

actions.label: Preview Tags
actions.description: Lists the streams each line matches and their new names. Changes nothing.

actions.label: Remove Tags
actions.description: Strips the team tags from stream names (the next M3U refresh would also restore them, until Apply runs again).

actions.label: Check Sync
actions.description: Shows what the sync watches and which new streams it would act on. Changes nothing.

actions.label: Run Teamarr Now
actions.description: Starts a Teamarr generation now and records the current streams as seen.
